stories.headline: Obama's lengthy reaction to Omar investigation triggers instant backlash: 'Spare me'
stories.note: Obama's long defense of Ilhan Omar amid the federal probe drew instant ridicule, tying Democrats' biggest name to a scandal-plagued congresswoman.

stories.headline: Epstein-linked billionaire pours $500K into super PAC backing Kentucky Democrat: 'Dirty Epstein-class money'
stories.note: A $500K check from an Epstein-linked billionaire to a pro-Democrat super PAC hands Republicans a ready-made attack in Kentucky.

stories.headline: Slotkin wants GOP prosecutions to deter young people from Trump administration jobs
stories.note: Sen. Elissa Slotkin's talk of prosecutions to scare young people away from Trump jobs feeds the GOP case that Democrats want payback.

stories.headline: Pro-Israel leader warns Democrats failing to condemn 'vicious Jew haters' in Congress
stories.note: A prominent pro-Israel leader says Democrats won't police antisemitism in their own ranks, widening a rift Republicans keep exploiting.

stories.headline: Booker rival who 'shoots from the hip' hopes viral debate moment can break GOP's Senate drought
stories.note: Cory Booker's Republican challenger is riding a viral debate moment in a bid to end the GOP's long Senate losing streak in New Jersey.

stories.headline: Trump tries different approach with Russia to bring Americans relief amid ongoing war with Ukraine
stories.note: Trump is trying a new tack with Russia aimed at easing costs for Americans, putting him on offense on the economy and foreign policy.
